items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: I wouldn't refuse Celestan because he'd get hot. So therefore when one didn't have it, the other one had it, you see. But I had to play with them, both of them.

ctx.x: And that's why I made my mistake. I wouldn't refuse Mr. Moret because he'd get hot. I wouldn't refuse Celestan because he'd get hot. So therefore when one didn't have it, the other one had it, you see. But I had to play with them, both of them. And then playing my Knight work, every night, every night, every night, no night off.
Tell me this, what happened when the Navy closed up Storyville? What did most of the musicians do? Did they still have enough jobs to play around that?
